explanation: the image booted to graphical.target with the privileged broker started and no failed unit
findings: SELinux is enforcing in the guest (audit records carry system_u:system_r), which the WSL qualification host does not do. Nothing in the host runtime qualification is evidence about SELinux; this boot is the first place that layer is even active.
The harness boots and greps a serial log. It performs no login, starts no graphical session, launches no capsule and draws no Companion. Every graphical claim in this phase remains unobserved.

host.note: the VM harness runs as root because qemu and the image live there; the guest is what is under test
